description: Find House of Commons votes (divisions) whose title contains a keyword, such as a bill name or topic, newest first, with the Aye and No totals, which side won and the tellers. Answers "did MPs vote on X and what was the result?". Source: UK Parliament Commons Votes API. Matches division titles only, not debate text; use commons_division_result for the names of MPs on each side. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, word or phrase to find in the division title, e.g. "Railways" or "Assisted Dying"

take.description: int, optional, number of divisions to return, 1-25, default 10

name: commons_division_search
